text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving in front of the station on my day 
off... there was a corner that looked 
unusually vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this angle looks great♪ Both Curren 
and Maya-chan look totally perfect, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ As expected of Curren-chan, you're a 
genius~♪ Then how about a pose like this—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Onii-chan? No way, what a 
coincidence♪ Or could it be... destiny?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sis?! No way, what a coincidence♪ Or 
could it be destiny?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~! It's totally destinyâ So awesome, 
so great!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Curren-chan! Since we're here, 
let's hang out with Trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Thank you~! Isn't that 
great, Big Bro? Come on, let's go, let's 
go♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Thank you~! Isn't that 
great, Big Sis? Come on, let's go, let's 
go♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, which photo booth should we choose? 
Curren doesn't really know much about 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I used the one in the back the other day, 
and it made me look so glittery and cute 
even without filters!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Either is fine with Maya, but Curren-chan 
prefers a natural look, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Maya-chan gets it♪ Let's try taking a 
picture with that then!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah~! That phone case is so cute! It's all 
glittery☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's not too flashy, totally Maya-chan's 
style♪ Swapping the cover to match your 
outfit is so chic!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"That's it! Curren-chan, you're a genius☆ 
Maya's gonna buy that~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their play continued on afterward... and 
where they ended up was a boutique highly 
recommended by Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They've got everything from edgy to 
high-fashion styles here, so it's fun just 
browsing around☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, today is the practical session! I 
want Curren-chan to try on lots of 
different outfits☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: For Curren~? Why?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan, you have your own fashion 
rules, right? That's cute and all, but 
sometimes I wanna see a totally different 
vibe from you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆ There are just some things 
you can never compromise on, right~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
As expected~♪ Like the ratio of exposed 
skin, or miniskirts being a must, Curren 
has a few personal rules.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because that's just undeniably cute, I 
never really thought about switching 
things up, but~..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, okay. If Onii-chan insists, 
maybe I could consider it for you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, okay. If Onee-chan insists, 
maybe I could consider it for you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay~☆ Come on, come on, Trainer, ask 
Curren Chan for a favor☆

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *staaare...*

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, well if you insist♪ Then~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aggressive Curren or chic Curren— which 
one do you like better?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? So you prefer aggressive types, Big 
Brother? Heheh~..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? So you prefer the aggressive types, 
Big Sis? Heheh, I see...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm-mmm~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if you're going for aggressive and 
edgy~... maybe a harness or fishnet 
tights?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's nice too, but Onii-chan probably... 
likes those kinds of extreme things♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's nice too, but Onee-chan probably... 
likes those kinds of extreme things♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? That totally see-through one!? 
W-Wow... So mature...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, tell me about those bold, 
daring shops☆ I know you've been looking 
them up just in case♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ack, you saw right through me~?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Just you wait, Onii-chan, okay? I'll 
show you... Curren's killer look...♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Just you wait, Onee-chan, okay? I'll 
show you... Curren's killer look...♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Maybe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The high-energy shopping spree continued 
after that, with Curren Chan teasing me 
relentlessly... It turned out to be quite 
an exhausting day, both mentally and 
physically.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Onii-chan, do you like more mature girls?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Onee-chan, do you like more mature girls?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When I think of "haute couture" or "mode," 
my gut impression is something monochrome 
and understated.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Which means~... adults really do prefer 
mature women, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I get it, Big Brother. Then 
Curren will—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I get it, Big Sister. Then 
Curren will—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Curren needs to teach Big 
Brother all about "cuteness" once again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Curren needs to teach Big 
Sister all about "cuteness" once again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because it seems you still don't 
understand that 'cute' encompasses 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"And that means, Maya-chan, shopping is 
officially over for now! Time to start our 
Cutie Lessons~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆ Sounds fun～! Maya wants to 
take the lesson too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the study session led by Curren 
Chan began, and it beg—and it—she's so 
cute, Curren Chan!!
